still_usable_note: Microsoft states that Basic authentication is now disabled in all tenants for the affected Exchange Online protocols. Disablement was phased, so this record does not invent one universal final-completion date.
summary: Microsoft removed Basic authentication from affected Exchange Online protocols and requires Modern authentication/OAuth-based access instead.
current_state: Basic authentication is disabled in all tenants for the affected protocols; applications must use Modern authentication or another supported method.
known_unknowns: The service-wide disablement was phased across tenants and cloud environments, so October 1, 2022 is recorded as the main rollout boundary rather than a fabricated universal completion date.
notes: Current Microsoft documentation confirms the present all-tenants disabled state.
